product_id.description: The ERP's readable product ID: P plus at least 3 digits (P001, P1000).

supplier_id.description: The ERP's readable supplier ID: S plus at least 3 digits (S001, S1000).

purchase_order_id.description: The ERP's order number, as the manager sees it.

instant.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant, always with Z.

business_date.description: Calendar date in Africa/Cairo, computed by the ERP (D-04).

positive_quantity.description: Whole units; the ERP stores whole units.

cursor.description: Opaque; clients must not parse it.
